signatures.DocumentStorage.store: StoredBlob store(BlobWriteRequest request); throws WriteOnceViolationException or StorageUnavailableException
signatures.DocumentStorage.open: byte[] open(BlobRef ref); a missing blob is StorageUnavailableException(BLOB_MISSING); readiness is unchanged
signatures.BlobRef: record BlobRef(String container, String blobName); String storageRef(); static BlobRef fromStorageRef(String)
signatures.BlobWriteRequest: record BlobWriteRequest(UUID caseId, UUID documentId, int docVersion, boolean writeOnce, BlobRef source)
signatures.StoredBlob: record StoredBlob(BlobRef ref, String sha256, long size, boolean existing)
signatures.StorageReadiness: record StorageReadiness(boolean ready, List<String> reasons, Instant checkedAt)
signatures.source_rule: source is the intake container (any name), or, only when writeOnce=true, the standard container at the same name {caseId}/{documentId}/v{docVersion} (D-RCV-31 re-store; source kept). Any other source container raises IllegalArgumentException with no storage call
signatures.flag_off: DocumentStorage and DocumentContainers beans present; store and open raise StorageUnavailableException(NOT_READY); readiness() returns ready=false and reasons=[FLAG_OFF]
signatures.store_when_not_ready: Single-flight readiness probe with a deadline of rwb.dochub.storage.timeout-seconds (10, AC10). A fresh NOT_READY (younger than rwb.dochub.storage.readiness-recheck-seconds, 30, assumed) raises NOT_READY at once with no storage call; otherwise the caller joins or starts the one probe and waits at most timeout-seconds: probe NOT_READY raises NOT_READY, the wait ending first raises TIMEOUT
signatures.readiness_writer: Only the readiness probe writes readiness. store and open outcomes TIMEOUT, transport UNAVAILABLE (5xx or IO after retries) and ContainerNotFound request one background probe (single-flight; none if a probe is in flight or ended within readiness-recheck-seconds); BLOB_MISSING, ACCESS_REFUSED, write-once refusals, conflicts and other 4xx never change readiness
